description: Navigate to the 'Number Munchers' activity in GCompris (Math > Calculation category). Select the 'Primes' level if prompted (or play the default if it requires eating primes). Control the Muncher character using arrow keys to move and Space/Enter to eat numbers. Your goal is to eat ONLY Prime Numbers (e.g., 2, 3, 5, 7, 11...) while avoiding the enemies (Troggles). Achieve a score of at least 20 points. Take a screenshot of your high score when finished.
